title: Quick chat, emotes, horn and rider safety
summary: Online riders can talk without free text: a radial wheel of eight preset lines, eight emotes and a horn, with mute, block and report built in.
details: Chat button, wheel, bubbles over riders and a feed. Keys T, 1-8, Shift+1-8 and B; Select on a controller. The horn is a synthesized two-tone sound heard within 300 ft.
Server limits: 3 lines per 5 s then a 5 s lockout, emotes every 2 s, horn every 1 s. Only preset ids travel, never text.
Safety: per-rider mute, Mute all chat, persistent block and a one-tap report from the rider page (fixed reasons, rate-limited). Host/Join Game also gets a name dice for a rider name.

Verification: unit tests plus tools/test_engine_multiplayer_chat.mjs with two clients on a local server. Host-only evidence: browser tests on host Chromium against a local game server. Nothing was checked on physical phones.
limitation: Riders without an identity token are still blocked by shown name, and the server still relays a blocked rider's chat (the client hides it). Reports are stored for review only; there is no moderation tooling yet. The rider's own bubble is not drawn over their own quad. The rider page capture was faint, so it is not published.
